objective: Prioritize monetizable information-edge models over standalone spread capture.

experiments.edge_source: Past-only signed trades, quote velocity, depth depletion and refill imbalance lead the next executable Kalshi price.
experiments.signal: signed_flow_score implies a same-direction executable move above round-trip costs and safety buffer
experiments.action: one-contract BUY_YES or BUY_NO marketable limit; exit at frozen horizon or reversal
experiments.fastest_validation: TRAIN 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-15; sprint-held-out validation 2026-07-17 (not a globally untouched confirmation set); simple regularized baseline before complex models
experiments.failure: validation instability or nonpositive executable fee-after pathwise PnL

experiments.edge_source: Mapped same-event leaders and payout-linked siblings update asynchronously or violate a statewise executable constraint.
experiments.signal: mapped leader-follower lag or payout residual remains above all-leg cost and orphan-risk buffer
experiments.action: first revision defensive cancel/reprice only; cash trade requires complete payout-verified vector
experiments.fastest_validation: lead-lag event study on verified same-event subset with time-reversal and unrelated-root placebos
experiments.failure: placebos match, mapping is incomplete, or executable residual is nonpositive

experiments.edge_source: Settlement index and liquid external spot move before mapped Kalshi crypto contracts or imply a different digital probability.
experiments.signal: conservative index-and-volatility fair interval differs from executable Kalshi price beyond all costs and basis uncertainty
experiments.action: one-contract Kalshi outcome only; no spot hedge or leverage in revision one; exit on convergence, reversal or timeout
experiments.fastest_validation: 24-72 hour prospective BTC/ETH capture using transparent digital-probability and naive baselines
experiments.failure: clock-aligned lead vanishes, basis risk dominates, or fee-after executable PnL is nonpositive

experiments.edge_source: Verified external state or odds shocks reach mapped Kalshi quotes with an actionable delay.
experiments.signal: external probability shock remains absent from Kalshi executable price at realistic action time by more than total cost
experiments.action: cancel stale quote first; directional one-contract entry only with exhaustive mapping; exit on catch-up, reversal or timeout
experiments.fastest_validation: no-ML event study at 10ms through 5s with time-reversal, unrelated-event and delayed-source placebos
experiments.failure: timing cannot be proven, placebos match, or post-latency discrepancy is nonpositive

experiments.edge_source: Authoritative live state or consensus odds changes conditional payout probability before Kalshi fully reprices.
experiments.signal: calibrated fair-value interval lies beyond executable Kalshi price after fees, impact, latency, model uncertainty and safety buffer
experiments.action: one-contract Kalshi marketable limit; exit on fair reversal or frozen horizon; no settlement hold in revision one
experiments.fastest_validation: single mapped market class using consensus odds fair first; direct state model second
experiments.failure: out-of-sample calibration fails or executable fee-after edge is nonpositive
